newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton prices seen fluctuating.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton prices seen fluctuating.

text.p: Cotton prices are likely to fluctuate in the next trading week starting Saturday on fears of a crop shortfall, dealers said on Thursday.

Prices closed steady on the last trading session on Tuesday, one dealer at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said. The market was closed on Wednesday and Thursday due to a local holiday. It will reopen after the Friday weekend.
In the kerb market, the rate for the NIAB-78 variety was quoted around 2,375 rupees ($59.11) per maund (37.32 kg).
